solid carbon co-product per GJ of hydrogen (HHV): CH4 -> C + 2 H2 gives 12.011 t C per 4.032 t H2, about 3 t C per t H2 (boulamanti_2017_001 prints 4 kg CH4 -> 1 kg H2 + 3 kg C); 3 / 141.79 GJ per t H2 = 0.02116 t C per GJ H2. Recorded so the levelized cost incl. energy can credit the carbon (D19)

electricity exported from the lignin-fired CHP: DEA 2026 sheet 106 prints 0.04 MWh electricity per MWh input beside 0.29 ethanol (0.138 per GJ ethanol; 0.05/0.37 in 2030); recorded as a co-product so the biomass burned on site (lignin and residues, PB012) is not read as all lost (Brad 2026-10-28)
power from the waste-heat boilers burning the coal volatiles: about 0.5 MWh (0.4-0.65) per t coke exported (judgement); in CIMS a negative electricity request (node alignment ST07)
